node.title: XR uniform higher-rank selectors reduce to bounded split-pencil trades
node.statement: For every high-core selector rank s=a+1 in the uniform flat-nullity cell u=v=0, tangent genericity gives a coherent GRS_a split pencil on N=R+a coordinates with block size a+h and pair cap a. Any over-budget family contains a minimal Maxwell core hL=2v-2a+e, 0<=e<=h-1, whose parity stack has an extra right-kernel class and at least e+1 dual-product-code trade relations. Active block rows have weight at least a+1 and active coordinates degree at least three. Trade rank one is impossible; trade rank two has 4<=t<=a+2, active union a+2<=rho<=2a, and a polynomial-pencil model of degree at most a-1. This is the arbitrary-rank uniform-cell structural compiler, not an aggregate slope payment.
